summary: Tested centralised PLACEHOLDER pricing system: backend GET/PUT /api/pricing endpoints, program detail pricing section, From-price labels across cards, trilingual ES/EN/FR localisation, and the /admin Precios tab. Backend pytest: 4/4 PASS. Frontend pricing section, from-prices, trilingual switch, and admin editor all work correctly. Found several MISSING from-price testids on hub/plan/home-featured surfaces listed in the spec.

ui_bugs.issue: No journey-from-* testids found on the home page; only home-all-trips-from-* (40) exist. Per spec, featured journeys should expose journey-from-* labels.
hub-program-from-* testids MISSING on hub-preview-card-* elements. Spec expects hub-program-from-* visible on hub program cards. (itinerary-from-* x4 and overview-from-* x4 are present and correct.)
plan-trip-reco-from-* testids MISSING and page body does NOT contain '€790'. RecoCard does not render the FromPrice label.

action_items: Add FromPrice (journey-from-{slug}) to FeaturedJourneys cards on the home page.
Add FromPrice (hub-program-from-{slug}) to hub-preview-card-* items in ItineraryHubPage.jsx so /viajes/surdemarruecos hub cards expose the 'Desde €790 por persona' label.
Add FromPrice (plan-trip-reco-from-{slug}) to RecoCard in PlanificaTuViajePage.jsx — currently no €790 label renders there at all.
(Optional) Audit /proximas-salidas: visible 'Desde €790 por persona' shows fine via reused home-all-trips-from-* testids, but adding dedicated departure-from-* testids would match other surfaces.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/pricing.js + pricingStore.js + FromPrice.jsx + PricingSection.jsx — clean single source of truth; merge function and getFromPrice (lowest across all low/high tiers) are correct.
Backend PUT /api/pricing correctly: 401 without token, 422 on empty tiers, 200 on valid; persistence verified via subsequent GET.

Admin tab Precios: editor inputs, auto Desde preview (€790), save with success message all wired up. Localisation chips (Abril/Agosto/Octubre/Semana Santa/Navidad/Nochevieja/Festivos) render correctly in the pricing section.
seed_data_creation: None. Pricing tiers were saved during admin test with the same default values (2p:1010/1085, 3p:865/920, 4p:790/835) — From price remains €790.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pricing API fully working (pytest 4/4). Program detail pricing section is perfect on /viajes/desierto_atlas/programa_4n_5d (3 tier rows €1.010/€1.085, €865/€920, €790/€835; all 7 high-season chips; occupancy note; pricing-from='Desde €790 / por persona'; sticky nav PRECIOS anchor #pricing scrolls correctly). Trilingual switching via [data-testid='lang-button-es|en|fr'] localises both the pricing section headers (Precios/Pricing/Tarifs, Viajeros/Travellers/Voyageurs, Temporada baja/Low season/Basse saison) and FromPrice label (Desde/From/Dès & por persona/per person/par personne). Admin /admin login (admin-login-password='xaluca' + admin-login-submit), then admin-tab-pricing → admin-pricing editor with 3 sets of people/low/high inputs, admin-pricing-from auto-preview '€790', admin-pricing-save shows '✓ Precios guardados. Se reflejan en toda la web.' From-price testids present and showing '€790': home-all-trips-from-* (40), region-from-{south,north,all} (3), trip-from-* (13), proxima-from-0, itinerary-from-* (4), overview-from-* (4). MISSING: journey-from-* (home), hub-program-from-* (hub), plan-trip-reco-from-* (plan page also has NO €790 visible).
rca_of_the_issue: The missing from-price testids on hub/plan/home-featured surfaces indicate that FromPrice was not wired into those card components (FeaturedJourneys, hub-preview-card in ItineraryHubPage, RecoCard in PlanificaTuViajePage). The PlanificaTuViajePage RecoCard is the most impactful miss because the page contains NO €790 text at all — users land there without seeing the placeholder price.
